title: Synthetic Cobalt-Promoted CO2 Hydrogenation Under Low-Pressure Flow

paragraphs.text: We synthesized sample Co-Ni-FlowB (5 wt% Co-10 wt% Ni/CeO2) and measured CO2 conversion at 573 K and 0.5 bar with space velocity 10-5 s-1 equivalent residence rate.
Co-Ni-FlowB achieved 79.1% CO2 conversion with R2 = 0.994 in kinetic fitting, whereas unpromoted Ni/Al2O3 (commercial pellet Lot-Z) showed 61.0% conversion under 573 K and 0.5 bar.

Density functional theory (DFT) microkinetic modeling (RPBE+U) indicated an apparent barrier of 0.81 eV on stepped Co-Ni sites, contrasting with lower barriers reported on oxide-vacancy alumina models.
